brief:
Transcribe video/audio assets hosted on a FedWiki (Smallest Federated Wiki) page using local whisper.cpp. Use when the user points to a FedWiki page or assets folder (e.g. http://david.local/.../workshop-videos) and wants the videos transcribed to text/subtitles. Enumerates the assets folder, streams each file over the network, extracts audio with ffmpeg, and runs whisper.cpp (large-v3-turbo) to produce .txt/.srt/.vtt.

End-to-end flow: **FedWiki assets folder → list files → stream audio (ffmpeg) → transcribe (whisper.cpp) → .txt/.srt/.vtt**.

If building whisper.cpp fresh: it needs CMake + a C++ compiler. VS Build Tools 2019 bundles both — `cmake -B build -G "Visual Studio 16 2019" -A x64` then `cmake --build build --config Release`. (CMake is at `...\BuildTools\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe`.)

Individual files are served (no auth) at `{WikiBase}/assets/{folder}/{filename}`. Filenames may contain spaces/apostrophes (`Groundhog Day.mov`, `don't-panic.mov`) so URL-encode each segment.
